name: web-basic
description: A web app that runs in the browser: React + TypeScript + Vite, tested with Vitest. Data is kept in the browser.
notes: About the starter app (no need to read these files):
- src/App.tsx is one React component that shows the app's name in an <h1>. src/main.tsx mounts it; leave that as it is. There is no CSS file yet: add src/App.css and import it in App.tsx.
- src/App.test.tsx has one test, 'the app opens' (it looks for the <h1>). Keep it and add your tests to that file.

- Tests use Vitest with test and expect available everywhere, plus Testing Library: import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react' and userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event'. Each test starts with an empty localStorage and a clean page.
